title: Wiarumus language
description: Torricelli language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Wiarumus, or Mandi, is a Torricelli language of Papua New Guinea, spoken in a village of just under 500. Only those villagers born before ca. 1940 can speak it. It is spoken in the Mandi village, Turubu Rural LLG, East Sepik Province.
